researchNotes:
# NEXUS Explorer: sourced draft catalog
Research date: November 4, 2026. This is a starting dataset, not approved marketing copy.

## What is ready
31 distinct product, platform, software, or program records with primary-source citations. 31 media references (images, videos, documents) are connected to records. Markets are provisional navigation labels, not Leidos corporate segments. Missing specs remain empty, not invented. `itemKind` distinguishes programs/software from physical products. Some products share an integrated system and should not be shown as unrelated alternatives.

## Equipment-first experience recommendation
Make the current vehicle module about the Leidos mission equipment. Suggested working title: Mobile Counter-UAS, with JLTV labeled as the carrier. Start with MXR sensing and an AirShield system story. Do not label the existing cannon/turret placeholder as MXR. MXR is radar, not a weapon turret. The official AM2FP demonstration identifies a HMMWV; research did not establish a specific JLTV installation. Keep the physical arrangement illustrative until the product owner confirms the variant, model, mounting, dimensions, and approved claims.

Related products worth investigating for future vehicle stories are ADEPT navigation software, AD16 communications, and Bloodhound sensing. Public descriptions establish roles, not that those items fit the current JLTV mesh. IFPC and Mjolnir are separate systems, not verified plug-in JLTV accessories. CUGAR is a reusable interceptor in the AM2FP demonstration, not a turret.

For the sea environment, Sea Archer is a strong platform candidate with documented modular payloads. Sea Dagger and the Sea Hunter/Seahawk autonomy story offer different experiences. LAVS sensing and Sea Castle underwater support should be described in their documented roles, without implying interchangeable mounting. For air, AGILEPOD is a plausible modular-payload story; verify aircraft and payload pairing before building a specific installation.

## Editorial holds and contradictions
- GeoRover is retired and excluded.
- Security screening products are held after the October 2026 Analogic transaction. An old Leidos URL is not sufficient proof of unchanged portfolio ownership.
- The current maritime page calls Sea Specter a surface vessel; older announcement wording grouped it differently. Current wording is used and the discrepancy retained.
- GroundAware GA1360 has conflicting walker-range values on its official page. That claim is omitted.
- My Military Health is a DHA collaborative program, not a standalone Leidos-owned product.
- Do not present exercise results, aggregate fleet mileage, or relative improvements as guaranteed product specifications.

## Safe CMS import
Import into a draft collection. Preserve stable IDs and every citation/uncertainty. Do not silently fill empty arrays, convert unknown values to zero, or mark imported entries approved. Each field's source IDs resolve against the included source registry; specs carry their own source IDs. Media references have their source page, access date, access status, and rights status. Image URLs were extracted from official HTML; most image content and video playback have not been independently inspected. Widen landing pages are document references, not necessarily direct downloadable PDFs. No files are cleared for redistribution just because publicly accessible. Before publication, approve product inclusion, exact variant claims, taxonomy, media rights/accessibility, and attribution. Keep unsupported spec sections hidden.

## Source highlights
- MXR: https://www.leidos.com/insights/new-radar-sees-threats-others-miss
- HMMWV demonstration: https://www.leidos.com/insights/advanced-multilayered-mobile-force-protection-excels-mfix-demo
- Maritime: https://www.leidos.com/markets/maritime
- Portfolio change: https://www.leidos.com/insights/leidos-security-enterprise-solutions-and-analogic-close-deal-strengthen-global-security

All additional per-record URLs are in the JSON. This initial scan is substantial but not exhaustive; catalog pages may be stale. No external contacts were made and no production content was changed.
